title: Stasis graphics: Seal host-controlled sprite display lists [chesstd]
description:
Split child of Maddox #399. Repository scope: chesstd only.

Implement only the portion of the parent objective that belongs in the chesstd repository. References to other repositories in the preserved parent context are sibling coordination requirements, not authority to edit those repositories. Keep branches, commits, pull requests, validation, and repository labels scoped to this repository. Record cross-repository dependencies explicitly on the sibling or parent task.

Parent objective and acceptance context
---------------------------------------
Make the Stasis graphics frame blob a sealed semantic display list so games cannot bypass host-controlled sprite resource management. Replace public/raw sprite handles in game-facing APIs with opaque or otherwise non-forgeable typed sprite references; restrict compiler-owned stdlib/internal imports and privileged graphics externs; validate final IR provenance; keep command storage inaccessible to projects; resolve resource generations, atlas domains, UVs, fallback, and backend bindings exclusively in the shared host path. Provide a typed bounded presentation-command form for painter-ordered queues, migrate ChessTD and representative first-party games away from gfx_cmd_sprite(handle, ...) and Sprite.handle submission, add compile-fail bypass tests plus JIT/AOT/mobile/Web contract tests, preserve transparent order and hot-reload behavior, and document staged compatibility/removal. This follows merged StasisLang PR #628 and should use its interleaving evidence to ensure the host retains stable resource identity.

Acceptance: `stasis fmt --check`, `stasis check`, and `stasis test` pass after coordination with the reopened ChessTD SpriteRef migration task.
